# 1. The relationship between tcc and lst 2013-2021
```{r}
# plot scatter
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
source("script/plot_scatter_lst_tcc.R")


# year 2015
rs_tcc <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/nlcd_tcc/clipped/nlcd_tcc_NY_2015.tif"))
rs_lst <- raster(stringr::str_c("data/raw/NY/LST_L8/year_mean/2015.tif")) %>%
  projectRaster(., rs_tcc, method = "ngb")



output_dir <- stringr::str_c("result/orig_scatter/tcc_lst_2015.jpg")

scatters_tcc_lst(tree= rs_tcc, lst = rs_lst,
                 xlabel = expression(bold(paste('Tree Canopy Cover / %', sep = ''))),
                 ylabel = expression(bold(paste('Land Surface Temp / °C', sep = ''))), 
                 output_file = output_dir)
  
```

# 2. read in campaigns data for NYC
```{r}
# Upper 2021-07-24
Upper_point_af <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Heat_Map_Camp/bronx-man/af_trav.shp')
upper_ndvi <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/ndvi/upper_nyc_20210724.tif")
upper_af_ndvi <- terra::extract(upper_ndvi, Upper_point_af)
Upper_point_af <- cbind(Upper_point_af, setNames(list(upper_af_ndvi[,2]), "ndvi"))

# Lower Brooklyn 2022-07-30
Lower_point_af <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Heat_Map_Camp/brooklyn/af_trav.shp') %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct("2022-07-20 15:30:00", format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
lower_ndvi <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/ndvi/lower_nyc_20210730.tif")
lower_af_ndvi <- terra::extract(lower_ndvi, Lower_point_af)
Lower_point_af <- cbind(Lower_point_af, setNames(list(lower_af_ndvi[,2]), "ndvi"))
  

```
